name: Decline Sit-Up
steps: Set an adjustable bench to a decline and hook your shins securely under the upper foot pads.
Lie back with your arms crossed over your chest and brace your abdomen.
Exhale, curl your upper back off the pad, and sit up smoothly toward your thighs.
Lower your torso slowly under control until your upper back rests back on the bench.
tips: Avoid throwing your arms forward or jerking your neck to start the ascent.
Stop before overarching your lower back at the bottom if you feel lumbar strain.
